query: WITH legacy AS (SELECT o."operationDate" AS business_date, o."itemId" AS item_id, o."operationType" AS item_type, SUM(COALESCE(o."inOverrideQtyGrams", 0)::numeric) AS legacy_in FROM public.operations o WHERE o."operationType" IN ('production', 'packaging') AND COALESCE(o."inOverrideQtyGrams", 0)::numeric > 0 GROUP BY o."operationDate", o."itemId", o."operationType"), confirmed AS (SELECT p."purchaseDate" AS business_date, p."itemId" AS item_id, SUM(p."quantityGrams"::numeric) AS purchase_in FROM public.purchases p WHERE p.status = 'confirmed' GROUP BY p."purchaseDate", p."itemId"), uncovered AS (SELECT l.business_date, l.item_id, l.item_type, l.legacy_in - COALESCE(c.purchase_in, 0) AS quantity FROM legacy l LEFT JOIN confirmed c ON c.business_date = l.business_date AND c.item_id = l.item_id WHERE l.legacy_in - COALESCE(c.purchase_in, 0) > 0) INSERT INTO public.purchases ("purchaseDate", "itemId", "inputQuantity", "inputUnit", "quantityGrams", "totalCost", "unitCostPerGram", status, "confirmedAt", note) SELECT u.business_date, u.item_id, u.quantity, CASE WHEN i."displayUnit" = 'pcs' THEN 'pcs'::purchase_unit ELSE 'g'::purchase_unit END, u.quantity, 0, 0, 'confirmed'::purchase_status, NOW(), '[system] Historical ledger In migration — purchase source normalization' FROM uncovered u JOIN public.items i ON i.id = u.item_id RETURNING id, "purchaseDate", "itemId", "quantityGrams";
